title: Banner MOTD and Console Line Security
description: Configure a legal warning banner and secure the console port with a password. Understanding banners and line security is essential for compliance with corporate security policies and the CCNA exam.
scenario: Company policy requires all network devices to display a legal warning before login. You must configure a MOTD banner containing 'Authorized Access Only', then secure the console port with a password and require login.

tasks.description: Configure a banner MOTD that contains 'Authorized Access Only'
tasks.hint: banner motd # Authorized Access Only # — use any delimiter character before and after the message

check.description: Banner MOTD must contain 'Authorized Access Only'
Console 0 must have a password configured

tasks.description: Enable service password-encryption to protect stored passwords
tasks.hint: In global config mode: service password-encryption

solutionWalkthrough: banner motd # Authorized Access Only — Unauthorized access is prohibited #
